admission.justification: Realized across site/package.json, config.mts, tokens.css and all four Vue components and required for the Phase 4 static site family; prevents broken script-off math or prose, V8 heap exhaustion on full-corpus MathJax 3 builds, double-prefixed base URLs, navbar title overflow past the 272px sidebar divider, dead outline/hash navigation into hidden zoom panels, keyboard focus traps and dark-dashboard aesthetic drift.

applicability: Static VitePress site configuration, package manifest, light-monograph CSS tokens and four globally registered Vue components under site/.
conditions: site/docs/.vitepress/config.mts enables markdown.math: true (paired with markdown-it-mathjax3 in site/package.json and site/package-lock.json), cleanUrls: true, appearance: false, VITEPRESS_BASE defaulting to /ar-rh-proof-skeleton/, full HTML title 'Riemann Hypothesis Proof Explainer' and themeConfig.siteTitle 'RH Proof Explainer'; site/package.json invokes docs:build via node --max-old-space-size=8192 ./node_modules/vitepress/bin/vitepress.js build docs so plain npm --prefix site run docs:build compiles the full eight-pillar MathJax 3 inline-SVG corpus without V8 heap exhaustion.

site/docs/.vitepress/theme/tokens.css constrains .VPNavBarTitle .title, .VPNavBarTitle.has-sidebar .title and their inner > span with single-line nowrap/ellipsis and min-width: 0 framing so the navbar title stays inside the 272px sidebar header with zero horizontal overflow across desktop and narrow viewports.

VerificationBanner (defaulting repoLayout to 'condensed' for live comparator.json/GUIDE.md/INDEX.md links and preserving 'legacy' comparator/ and verification/NOTES.md links), ConceptReveal, ConceptHover and ZoomTabs (defaulting Level 1 to id 'first-principles' / label 'Level 1 · First-Principles' while accepting numeric ?level=1/2/3 and legacy ?level=abitur/#level-abitur aliases, activating owning hidden panels and scrolling via nextTick + double-rAF on initial load, hashchange, popstate and VitePress On-this-page outline clicks, preserving non-level heading hashes via replaceState and cleaning up listeners on unmount) preserve full script-off and print readability, keyboard operation without focus traps and high-contrast non-color-only visual cues.
exclusions: Interactive Cytoscape/D3 DAG explorer widgets and dark-mode theme toggling are outside the current editorial light VitePress shell.

evidence: npm --prefix site ci && npm --prefix site run docs:build + Playwright Look-and-Operate (round-1-evidence.tar.gz)

statement: The VitePress site configures build-time MathJax 3 SVG math (markdown.math: true + markdown-it-mathjax3 + committed package-lock.json + 8192 MB Node V8 heap cap on docs:build), configurable VITEPRESS_BASE defaulting to /ar-rh-proof-skeleton/, compact navbar siteTitle 'RH Proof Explainer' framed inside the 272px sidebar header while retaining full HTML title 'Riemann Hypothesis Proof Explainer', an editorial light palette, and accessible script-off-readable VerificationBanner (supporting condensed and legacy repoLayout links), ConceptReveal, ConceptHover, and ZoomTabs (defaulting Level 1 to 'first-principles' with legacy 'abitur' URL aliases and outline-click/hash/Back-Forward navigation) components.
title: Editorial light VitePress shell, MathJax 3 SVG and script-off Vue components
